item.title: NATO tests counter-drone systems from 12 nations at technical interoperability exercise
item.description: Counter-drone systems from 12 nations were tested together at NATO's technical interoperability exercise this week.
item.content:encoded:
Counter-drone systems from 12 nations were tested together at NATO's technical interoperability exercise this week.

The exercise assessed how detection, identification and defeat systems share data against small drones and loitering munitions.
